notes.title: Into the Ice pushed...
notes.notes:
...again.

We are sorry to do that over and over, but we don`t want to release the game without some key features we want to have, and at the moment, we can`t have them due to the ongoing work TGC is making on GameGuru, and more important, the lack of some needed updates on elements of GG that are still lacking.

Those who test for and with us or have access to our playable slices know that the AI is not in a bad place, that several key levels are basically ready to go, but  with the current state of GG we cannot do any plausible indoor scenes and levels without risking stability.

Once that is cleared, we will storm in and finish the game.
